newsitem.title: USA: Barclays investment arm names new trader.
newsitem.headline: Barclays investment arm names new trader.

text.p: BZW, the investment banking arm of Barclays Plc, said Tuesday that Frank Ren was named an associate director and long bond trader within BZW's Global Markets Division.
He will join the firm on July 1, a news release issued by BZW said.
Ren will trade the long end of the treasury market, specifically the long bond, long bond basis, and strips, the news release said.
Ren was formerly with Goldman, Sachs & Co, where he traded the long end of the curve, the release said.
